item_short_desc: Enhance your shooting experience with the Rothco Recoil Pad. This durable and easy-to-use slip-on recoil pad is designed for quality and functionality, providing added comfort and protection during use. Featuring a slip-on opening for quick installation, the butt end measures 5 1/4 inches x 1 3/4 inches, making it compatible with a wide range of rifles and shotguns. Whether you're at the range or in the field, the Recoil Pad delivers superior grip and cushioning for improved performance.
